a: DORA metrics: deployment frequency, lead time, change fail rate, MTTR.
MTTR is mean time to recovery after an incident.
Change fail rate is the fraction of deployments causing failures.
Lead time for changes measures commit-to-production time.
Continuous deployment automatically releases every green build.
Continuous delivery keeps software releasable at any time.
Trunk-based development integrates frequently to main.
Remove stale feature flags to reduce complexity.
Blameless culture improves learning from incidents.
Game days practice incident response under controlled failure.
